facts.text: The script exits 2 with a usage line on stderr when it is not given exactly two arguments.
It exits 2 when the first argument is not an existing file and names the missing binary.
BIN is turned into an absolute path by joining the absolute dirname with the basename.
The temporary directory is created with mktemp and removed by an EXIT trap.
When cygpath is on PATH the temp directory is converted with cygpath -m so native Windows binaries get a Windows path.
DOSSIER_DB is exported as smoke.db inside that temporary directory.
The marker token that the script dumps and then searches for is zyxwvquartz.
Every verb in the smoke test is scoped to the subject Smoke/Aot.
run captures stdout, strips carriage returns, and prints the output back out.
A non-zero exit makes run print the captured output, dump stderr, and fail with the exit code.
fail prints SMOKE FAILED to stderr and exits 1.
expect_contains fails with a message when the captured output lacks the given literal string.
expect_match treats its argument as an extended regular expression and tests it with grep -Eq.
The version step fails unless the binary output equals the expected version string exactly.
The dump step writes a note file containing the marker and dumps it with --source and --subject.
at: The %s marker proves dump and search work.

facts.text: After dump the output must contain a created entry, which is checked with a regular expression.
The search step searches for the marker token restricted to the smoke subject.
The check step requires the match field to be exact_name and at least one summarised fact.
The post step posts a note fact under the smoke subject and requires the status new.
The new fact id is extracted from the post output with sed, and an empty id fails the run.
at: could not read the new fact id

facts.text: The verify step runs with --require-current and requires current true and status live.
The changes step runs changes --last 1 and requires a non-zero next cursor plus a change row.
A compile at depth full must include the marker token in its JSON output.
A second compile run with --format markdown must also contain the marker token.
The mcp step pipes a JSONL session that starts with initialize and notifications/initialized into the binary.
The mcp session fails if the output contains an error field or lacks a result field.
The mcp step fails when verify_facts does not report the posted fact as current.
at: verify_facts did not report the posted fact as current

facts.text: The publish step fails when manifest.json is missing from the bundle or when no fact markdown file was written.
at: publish: manifest.json missing from the bundle

facts.text: The markdown bundle is imported into a second fresh database whose path is second.db.
The jsonl publish must write a manifest that declares the format dossier-jsonl/1.
After importing the jsonl bundle into a third database the script searches for the marker again.
On success the script prints SMOKE OK with the binary path and the expected version.
The show step requires both the fact id and the phrase posted fact in the output.
The Django tag defaults to 6.1.3 and can be overridden through the TAG environment variable.
The fact limit defaults to 50000 and is read from FACT_LIMIT.
The compile sample seed defaults to 42 through SEED.
The number of subjects sampled for compile latency defaults to 20 through SAMPLE.
The fact file cap defaults to 5000 and is read from FACT_FILE_CAP.
The script runs the Release build of Dossier.dll under src/Dossier/bin/Release/net10.0.
The bundle is written to examples/django-bundle unless a first argument overrides it.
Raw timing files live in WORK, a mktemp directory under TMPDIR.
now prints wall-clock seconds with millisecond precision using perl Time::HiRes.
The tarball is downloaded with curl only when the extracted django directory does not exist yet.
The file list combines docs txt files, django py files and top-level md files, sorted under the C locale.
files_total is printed as the line count of the generated files list.
The ingest loop stops as soon as the accumulated fact total reaches FACT_LIMIT.
Files ending in .py are dumped with --kind code and everything else with --kind doc.
The subject for each file is its relative path with the extension stripped.
The number of created facts per file is read with jq from the created array.
mean_ms_per_file divides ingest seconds by files consumed and multiplies the result by 1000.
db_bytes reads the database size with stat -f %z on BSD and falls back to stat -c %s on GNU.
The ten slowest files are printed from the timing table sorted by its first column in reverse numeric order.
Each sampled compile uses budget 1200 with budget-mode strict and format json.
compile_p50_ms and compile_p95_ms are nearest-rank values over the sorted millisecond list.
conflicts_total accumulates the length of the conflicts array across every subject that has facts.
A probe publish with --facts detail counts the fact files a detail publish would write.
When the counted fact files exceed FACT_FILE_CAP the real publish uses --facts none instead of detail.
bundle_bytes sums the size of every file in the bundle with cat and wc -c.
facts_shown sums the Facts shown numerators from every subject index page in the bundle.
largest_subject_page_tokens estimates tokens as page bytes plus 3 divided by 4.
The compile sample picks subjects with a fixed-seed random value and sorts them by that value.
The eval script aborts on errors and unset variables because it sets -euo pipefail.
It exits 1 with a build hint when the Release Dossier.dll is missing.
The artifacts directory defaults to scripts/eval/artifacts and can be changed with EVAL_OUT.
The measured subject is Memos/Home for every arm.
A single temporary database is exported as DOSSIER_DB for the whole run.
The harness seeds a clean database by running scripts/seed.sh before measuring anything.
Arm A writes the result of search at limit 100 for the subject to arm-a.json.
Arm A2 reduces the same facts to one bare text line each with jq .hits[].text and drops ids and tags.
Arm C file paths come from git kind refs in the seed JSON files, deduplicated with sort -u.
Each fetched primary file is cached under primary as its path with slashes replaced plus the revision.
Each primary file is fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com with a 20 second curl timeout.
A failed fetch prints a SKIPPED line and does not abort the run.
Per-file tokens are estimated as the character count plus 3 divided by 4.
Screenshot tokens are shot count times width times height divided by 750.
The arm C artifact count adds the fetched file count and the declared screenshot count.
Arm B compiles the subject at budget 1200 with strict budget mode, depth full and markdown format.
ratio_ab prints inf instead of dividing when arm B has zero tokens.
b_facts counts dash-prefixed lines in arm-b.md until the first heading.
q_total counts the id fields in questions.json with grep -c.
q_unanswerable counts questions whose supporting_fragments array is empty.
The script warns that the B/C ratio is not valid when fewer primary files were fetched than planned.
The output ends with a markdown table of tokens per arm plus the B/C, B/A and B/A2 ratios.
The questions target the subject Memos/Home.
The declared estimator is chars/4 computed as ceil(length / 4).
The q-header-height question expects a conflict between 64 and 72 pixels.
The q-composer-rows question expects a conflict between 6 rows and 12 rows.
at: one records 6 rows and another records 12 rows.

facts.text: The q-save-shortcut question expects a conflict between Cmd+Enter on macOS and Ctrl+Enter elsewhere.
The q-composer-purpose answer is typing a memo, attaching media and choosing visibility.
at: Type a memo, attach media, and choose visibility.

facts.text: The q-list-order answer is newest first in a single column.
at: Newest first, in a single column.

facts.text: The q-offline-sync question is expected to be unanswerable because no offline sync behaviour is recorded.
The q-billing-invoice question is expected to be unanswerable because no billing or invoice screen is recorded.
The primary sources come from the usememos/memos repository.
The four primary source files are listed under git_paths and generated from the seed refs.
The comment says the generated git_paths list is checked by scripts/verify-refs.sh.
Arm C declares three screenshots at 1440 by 900 pixels.
The declared screenshot cost is count times width times height divided by 750.
The screenshot dimensions are declared because the seeded PNG is a 1x1 placeholder.
at: the seeded PNG is a 1x1 placeholder
